intro.text: A kind of symbol. Sarene's seon Ashe bears one, Aon Ashe, which glows at his centre.
Symbols that each stand for an idea, such as Aon Rao for spirit. They serve as a script, Elantrians draw them to work their magic, and Sarene's seon Ashe bears Aon Ashe at his centre.
Symbols that each stand for an idea, such as Aon Rao for spirit. They serve as a script, and Elantrians draw them to work their magic; the base Aon turns out to match the shape of Arelon.

description.text: Each Aon has a meaning. Aon Rao means spirit, which is why Raoden goes by Spirit inside Elantris.
Aons are also a script. Raoden finds a book written wholly in them that seems to deal with the Elantrians' magic, and sets out to translate it with the help of a dictionary.
Checked against a map, the base Aon matches the outline of Arelon down to its exact proportions.
